deck.ko: 굴러간 귤 하나를 쫓아 몸을 숙여도 레이어가 흐트러지지 않는 장보기 차림.
deck.en: A market-run layering that holds together even when you dive for a runaway orange.
deck.de: Ein Marktoutfit, das auch beim Bücken nach einer davonrollenden Orange sitzt.

intro.ko: 흐리고 6°C, 체감 3°C인 낮. 과일 가게 앞에서 귤이 굴러가자 장갑 낀 손이 먼저 나갑니다. 짧은 재킷과 접어 올린 데님 덕분에 쪼그려 앉아도 움직임이 가볍습니다.
intro.en: An overcast 6°C day that feels like 3°C. An orange escapes the fruit stand and a gloved hand gets there first; the short jacket and cuffed denim keep a quick crouch easy.
intro.de: Ein bedeckter Tag mit 6 °C, gefühlt 3 °C. Eine Orange rollt vom Obststand, die Hand im Handschuh ist schneller; kurze Jacke und umgeschlagene Jeans machen das Hocken leicht.

body.ko: 버건디 울 스카프까지 더해 목과 몸통을 따뜻하게 감쌉니다.
body.en: Finish the layers with burgundy wool scarf.

tip.ko: 스카프 끝을 재킷 밖으로 길게 빼 두면 올리브와 버건디 대비가 한눈에 보여요.
tip.en: Let the scarf ends hang outside the jacket so the olive-burgundy contrast reads at a glance.
tip.de: Die Schalenden außen über der Jacke hängen lassen, damit der Kontrast aus Oliv und Bordeaux sofort sichtbar ist.

ko.deck: 올리브 필드 재킷에 아이보리 리브 니트을 겹친 초겨울 캐주얼.
ko.intro: 기온 6°C, 체감 3°C의 흐린 낮을 위한 차림입니다.
ko.tip: 니트 위에 입고 앞섶을 살짝 열어 레이어를 보여주세요.

en.deck: Olive cropped field jacket over ivory ribbed knit for an early-winter casual look.
en.intro: For an overcast day at 6°C that feels like 3°C.
en.tip: Wear it over knitwear and leave the front slightly open to show the layer.

de.deck: Kurze olivgrüne Feldjacke über Elfenbeinfarbener Rippstrickpullover für einen lässigen Start in den Winter.
de.intro: Für einen bedeckten Tag bei 6 °C, gefühlt 3 °C.
de.tip: Über Strick tragen und vorne leicht offen lassen, damit die Schicht sichtbar bleibt.

copy.rewriteReason: b222 Claude Code copy rewrite under design/IMAGE_MAPPING_HANDOFF.md 5-1: delivered intro and tip were one sentence for all 10 looks (tip = the outer's how-to-wear), product how-to-wear used 9 template sentences for 66 products, decks listed product names (ko particle error '니트을', de case errors). Titles, pulls, bodies and product names/descriptions are kept verbatim; rewritten fields keep the delivered text in source* fields. Written from the 10 approved editorials.
